label: preparing
what: The record strongly supports people jointly preparing bread and stocking/operating a bakery, with builder placing lanterns at a site, baker baking bread and posting a bakery sign, and innkeeper/freight crafting wheat, baking and supplying bread. The mayor was not told about this preparation in the visible record. Innkeeper and freight knowingly helped with food production/supply; builder worked on the site and neighbour received/stored bread, though the record does not establish that neighbour knew of a coordinated plan. Baker, builder, innkeeper, and freight are clear participants; neighbour's participation in a shared preparation is less certain. The unrelated written appointment and mill-inspection notes do not establish a covert project.
